default.notes: A consular visa is required before travel; some nationalities need prior 'consulted' clearance from the National Institute of Migration. Confirm your category with a Honduran consulate.

groups.notes: CA-4 free movement — citizens of Guatemala, El Salvador and Nicaragua enter Honduras with a national ID card and no visa; the four countries form one migration zone.
Visa-free for up to 90 days, shared across the CA-4 zone (Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua) and extendable once. Complete the free online prechequeo form before arrival.

HN.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Honduran citizens.

CN.notes: Chinese citizens still need a consular visa. Procedures have been evolving since Honduras established relations with Beijing in 2023 — check with the nearest Honduran consulate.

TW.notes: Since Honduras switched recognition from Taipei to Beijing in March 2023, Taiwanese travellers' former visa-free status has been in doubt — confirm current requirements with a Honduran consulate before booking.
